statements.markdown: **Proposition 6.99 (No finite support has value one half).** *A finite sum of reciprocals of odd integers has odd denominator in lowest terms, so it cannot equal $1/2$. Applied to the denominators $2^a-1$, this proves that a support representing $1/2$ must be infinite, as used in Theorem [6.67](#record:257bm-c1).*
